set.text:
Attention Passengers

Because of track work, there will be changes at Eastgate Station from Saturday, May 10, through Sunday, May 18. Trains to Lakeview usually leave from Platform 2, but during this time they will use Platform 5. To reach Platform 5, use the stairs by the ticket office or take the elevator near the east exit. Trains to the airport will run every twenty minutes instead of every ten. Please allow extra time for your trip. Station staff in orange vests will be on every platform to help you. Printed maps are available at the information desk, and they are free. Passengers who use wheelchairs may ask for help at the desk. We are sorry for any inconvenience.
